src='''def find_boxes(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); out={}
    for v,n in c.items():
        if n<4: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
        if h>=3 and w>=3 and n==2*(h+w)-4:
            out[v]=(r0,c0,h,w)
    return out

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    bx=find_boxes(g)
    used={(i,j) for v,(r0,c0,h,w) in bx.items() for i in range(r0,r0+h) for j in range(c0,c0+w)}
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in used)
    for v,(r0,c0,h,w) in bx.items():
        area=(h-2)*(w-2); target=(area+1)//2
        cands=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==target]
        col=cands[0] if cands else min(cnt, key=lambda c: abs(cnt[c]-target))
        for i in range(r0+1,r0+h-1):
            for j in range(c0+1,c0+w-1):
                g[i][j]=col if (i-(r0+1)+j-(c0+1))%2==0 else 0
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in used: g[i][j]=0
    return g
'''
